resources.string: One download contains AAIdrive, Open Headunit and the projection add-on. Android installs these as three separate apps alongside this setup app. Each installation still needs your approval.
All three installers are included offline. Android Auto and Google Maps come from Google and are not included.

1. Open AAIdrive, grant its connection permissions, and connect the BMW. Check that ordinary AAIdrive apps appear in the car.

2. Android Auto and Google Maps must be installed and enabled. In phone Settings, search for Android Auto. Tap its version information ten times to enable developer settings, then use its menu to start the headunit server. You may need to start that server again each session.
%1$s is disabled — enable it in app settings
3. Open Open Headunit once and complete its setup. Use landscape orientation and hardware H.264 decoding. Its self-mode connects to Android Auto on this phone.

4. Open the projection add-on and choose “Start Android Auto”. Allow Android’s screen-capture prompt for the entire screen. Keep Open Headunit visible on the unlocked phone, then open the projection add-on in iDrive.

Screen-capture approval is required each session. Car connection speed limits the picture; audio uses the phone’s normal car connection. Stop sharing with Android’s screen-sharing control or the projection app. Physical phone/car compatibility still needs testing.
